Marta (sales): CedarHealth procurement needs a single ZIP for DD: SOC2 excerpt, pen-test letter on letterhead (external scan), ISO scope note, and an itemized Dedicated delta including KMS/HSM options. They want it by Fri COB.

Jon S (solutions): We can stand up a staging tenant in us-west with static egress IPs and presigned S3 upload. I'll prepare a 1-page connectivity runbook (bastion IP, sample curl).

Priya K (security): We'll provide a redacted SOC2 exec summary, control-matrix excerpt, network diagrams (hosted + dedi), and a pen-test attestation draft. Confirmed scope = external-only for now. For CMK request, KMS onboarding adds ~48-72h.

Noah P (pricing): Give me the Dedicated spec. If it's 2x A100-eq, ~2TB RAM, 3mo commit, preliminary delta = +$18,500/mo, one-time setup $6,250. CMK onboarding $1,200 one-time, HSM +$2,500/mo. I'll produce an itemized CSV.

Marta (sales): That's the spec they listed. Also asked whether audit-support engineering hours are billable. Can pricing include an optional hourly line?

Noah P (pricing): Yes — add "audit support (engineering)": $250/hr, estimate 8 hours default. I'll include that in the quote.

Sam L (legal): Pen-test letter: I have the template. Once Priya posts final wording and we have a signed one-page PoC scope from the customer, ops can sign on letterhead. Ops signature turnaround ~24 business hours.

Priya K (security): Timeline: I can assemble the ZIP (redacted SOC2, control matrix excerpt, diagram, pen-test draft, KMS checklist, IP allowlist, connectivity runbook) by Thu COB. If customer returns signed PoC scope today, legal+ops can get the signed letter on Thu/early Fri.

Marta (sales): Great — I'll ask CedarHealth for the signed PoC scope and set expectation: ZIP by Thu, signed pen-test letter by Fri if scope returned. Posting to procurement now. :thumbsup:
